english.title: Vagrant - being found in or upon enclosed premises
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), was found in

(A)_[or upon a dwelling house,]_
(B)_[or upon a warehouse,]_
(C)_[or upon a coach house,]_
(D)_[or upon a stable,]_
(E)_[or upon an outhouse,]_
(F)_[an enclosed yard,]_
(G)_[an enclosed garden,]_
(H)_[an enclosed area,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), for an unlawful purpose, namely **(..SPECIFY THE UNLAWFUL PURPOSE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 4 of the Vagrancy Act 1824.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
found in/upon enclosed premises
for an unlawful purpose

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence should not be used after 28th June 2026 due to repeal by the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022.
